evidence: The exposed 2026-02-02..06 week is development evidence only. This proposal is not an out-of-sample result or policy admission.

primary_query.families: Fit BB and VWAP as separate matched comparisons before combining them
primary_query.R: Use the decision-time R already frozen in crossing_map_target_v1.json
primary_query.event: At least one first-line checkpoint in the chosen map has net >= 2R by 300s
primary_query.meaning: Bounded amplitude opportunity; not an OPEN instruction or a risk-qualified trade

cohort_policy.initial_BCE_CE: Use the same fully mature origin cohort for positives and negatives, as in this study's reported distributions and constant-prior diagnostics. Do not mix all early witnessed positives with only fully mature negatives.
cohort_policy.partial_witness: E=1 can be logically known before all cells mature. Save that fact, but do not automatically admit it into ordinary calibrated BCE training: outcome-dependent inclusion can cause informative-censoring bias.
cohort_policy.complete_case_limit: Complete-case estimates describe the admitted population. Report coverage, rejected origins and their causal context; maturity selection does not establish unconditional calibration.
cohort_policy.censored_training: Partial observations require an explicitly specified survival/censoring likelihood and a check of the conditional censoring assumptions. Unsupported gaps are not negative events.
cohort_policy.unknown_direction: Do not label LONG_ONLY or SHORT_ONLY while the other side remains unresolved. No direction gradient for NONE or unknown direction.

loss.implemented: Mean over admitted roots of BCE(E) + 1[E=1] CE(direction|E). Both terms share the root denominator; separately averaging CE over positives would change the objective.
loss.probability: P(NONE)=1-pE; P(LONG_ONLY/SHORT_ONLY/BOTH)=pE*p(direction|E). This is the same four-state joint likelihood, not a proof of easier prediction.
proposed_auxiliary_heads: Per-line first-crossing time: discrete-time survival with supported observation exposure
Conditional net/R and full-prefix MAE/R quantiles at the crossing, evaluated on an explicitly defined observed cohort
Separate 900s and 1800s context queries; do not replace the primary deadline with a union of horizons
loss.gradient_scaling: Average line heads within each root before combining with the primary loss. Fix and report auxiliary weights using FIT only. Adding a near-duplicate scale must not automatically increase root weight.
loss.quality: Discounted max checkpoint quality is an optional hindsight utility target, not a probability. Keep it separate from calibrated event outputs.

dependence_and_split.physical_ids: Geometry/source identity independent of loss, thresholds and entries
dependence_and_split.weights: Any repetition counts or event weights must be computed inside FIT only. Roots may share several events; record overlap rather than assigning independent-row significance.
dependence_and_split.split: Chronological held-out sessions with maturity-based purging of training labels. Adjacent micro-recrosses remain dependent despite distinct IDs. ID grouping does not justify removing temporal controls or cooldown from a trading policy.

acceptance: Compare constant priors and flat four-state versus factorized heads on the same held-out cohorts. Measure calibration, time/net/risk errors, target stability and full gain-before-stop ordering separately. Economic acceptance additionally requires causal entry/exit decisions, delayed executable prices, costs and after-cost account growth; checkpoint quality alone is insufficient.
